BiblicalUsage: The word hosíōs carries the sense of holily, piously. In 1 Thessalonians 2:10, the text says "how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe."
TheologicalSignificance: In hosíōs I find no hidden theology; it simply means holily, piously.
